Market today: Tech is still under pressure, with headlines pointing to more pain ahead. The real driver is the debt market and oil prices, which are impacting broader sentiment.

Your holdings: CRWD (29.99%) and QQQ (-0.68%) are flagged for attention. SMH (-15.18%) and SMCI (-27.92%) are also in the red and need watching, especially with your margin.

Watch: Keep an eye on oil prices and any further developments in the debt market impacting tech.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your risk in these volatile tech and leveraged names.
plays: Trim QQQ if it breaks below 705, given the SELL status and market headwinds.
Consider trimming SMH if it fails to hold 540, given the SELL status and negative PnL.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
